title: Rey Gets the Upper Hand
description: Zorii Bliss and her crew hold the Resistance group captive. She reveals some information about Poe Dameron that Rey and Finn had no prior knowledge of. Poe was an old ally of Zorii's and together they ran spice. A fight breaks out between the two groups, though it doesn't last very long. Rey quickly gets the upper hand over Zorii, earning the smugglers respect and her help.
